content: {"a_point": "When refusing a request for legal assistance in a cantonal social insurance appeal, the court must assess whether the applicant's case has sufficient prospects of success, i.e., whether the chances of success are not manifestly lower than the chances of failure, based on a summary examination of the circumstances.", "b_propositions": [{"a_id": "S15", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}, {"a_id": "S21", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}, {"a_id": "S24", "b_speaker": "lower_court", "c_slot": "answer"}]}
